glosses: signalling, alarm (system), warning (system) (mechanical contrivance for awaking)

examples.en: My house doesn't have an alarm system.
My apartment has an alarm system.

examples.text: Сработала сигнализация, и всем пришлось эвакуироваться.
examples.en: The alarm rang and everyone had to evacuate.

examples.text: Том только что установил систему сигнализации в своём доме.
examples.en: Tom has just installed an alarm system in his house.
